info.title: GBLIN Protocol — x402 API
info.description: GBLIN is a basket token on Base mainnet (45% cbBTC, 45% WETH, 10% USDC) minted and redeemed at net asset value, with an on-chain Crash Shield that cuts the risk-asset weights during drawdowns. It is crypto exposure, not capital protection. Three endpoints are paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base, chain id 8453): a signed risk attestation, a receipt in a public transparency log, and an x402 endpoint liveness catalog. The vault reads, the treasury plan and the unsigned calldata routes are free.
info.x-guidance: Free routes need no payment: call them with a plain GET. Start with /api/x402/treasury-state for NAV, basket and shield status. To decide what to do with idle USDC, call /api/x402/plan?wallet=0x...&daily_burn=25: it returns the cash to keep liquid, the surplus, a mint simulation with live fees and an estimate of exiting the same day. Nothing executes: /api/x402/invest and /api/x402/jit return unsigned calldata that the wallet owner reviews and signs. Paid routes answer HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment requirements (exact scheme, USDC on Base); retry with the signed payment header. Use /api/x402/attestation before moving capital (free sample: /api/x402/attestation-sample), POST /api/x402/seal after an action you may need to prove, and /api/x402/catalog before paying an x402 service you have not used recently. The same tools are available as a free MCP server at https://mcp.gblin.digital/mcp.

x-payment.facilitator: Coinbase CDP (https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402); PayAI (https://facilitator.payai.network) only when CDP is disabled

get.description:
NAV in USD, basket composition with dynamic weights, Crash Shield status.

Free since 2026-09-27: no payment required. Also available free in the MCP server (@gblin-protocol/mcp-server).

nav_usd.description: Net asset value in USD per GBLIN

basket.description: Current basket entries with dynamic weights

meta.description: Contract and chain metadata for this reading

get.description: Turns a wallet and a spending rate into a reviewable plan: the operating cash to keep in USDC (the larger of reserve and daily_burn x days), the surplus above it, a simulation of minting that surplus into GBLIN with every fee read from the vault, the estimated value of exiting the same day, a trial amount, blockers, and the URLs that prepare unsigned calldata. Nothing is executed. Provide daily_burn or reserve.

parameters.name: daily_burn
parameters.description: USD the wallet spends per day

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of spending to keep liquid (1-365, default 7)

parameters.name: reserve
parameters.description: USD to keep liquid regardless of spending

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: Size in USDC of a first trial (default 100)

A free static example with the same shape and EIP-712 schema as the paid risk attestation from /api/x402/attestation, for integration testing. The data is frozen and expired: never a live risk signal.

Perishable (10-minute) proof of the current BTC/ETH risk regime (calm | elevated | crash) derived from the on-chain Crash Shield. Attach it to your action as portable proof-of-diligence; any counterparty verifies it in one step (EIP-712 signature when an attestor key is configured, else a tamper-evident attestation_id). Expires in 10 minutes, so re-fetch each decision cycle.

Requires an x402 USDC payment on Base mainnet ($0.003 USDC). Free verifier: verify_risk_attestation in @gblin-protocol/mcp-server.

post.summary: AI Action Receipt: seal the hashes of an action
post.description:
Seal the SHA-256 hashes of an AI action into GBLIN's public append-only RFC 6962 transparency log. Returns a portable receipt: Ed25519 signature, inclusion proof and signed checkpoint; the tree root is anchored daily on Base. Body: {action, input_hash, output_hash?, agent_id?, tool?, meta?}. The labels are public; only the hashes protect the content.

Requires an x402 USDC payment on Base mainnet ($0.0045 USDC). Free demo (5 per day per IP) and free reading: https://mcp.gblin.digital/log

action.description: Short public label for what the AI did. Published in the log: identifiers only, never secrets.

input_hash.description: sha256 of your input, 64 hex chars (0x prefix optional)

meta.description: Extra JSON object as a string (optional). Published.

get.description:
Call before your agent pays an x402 service it has not used recently: is that endpoint actually alive? Liveness of the ~200 most recently updated Bazaar listings, probed in rotation: HTTP status, latency, last-OK time and consecutive failures per endpoint. Measurements only, no judgements; the probes never pay.

Requires an x402 USDC payment on Base mainnet ($0.005 USDC). Free aggregate view: https://mcp.gblin.digital/catalog
